angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,247,390 km at 897.73 pc = 0.02 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 1.1139 +/- 0.0107 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 897.73 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.793 +/- 0.043 solar radii from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract): 1,247,390 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.374 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6297 +/- 60 K from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-5.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.069, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-5: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-5 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.04 dex, from Esteves et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-5 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.65242, from Gajdoš et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019RAA....19...41G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-5 (pscomppars): age 2.88 Gyr, from Fulton & Petigura 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..264F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-5 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.8 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
